one_liner: Reconciles an admitted patient's pre-admission medicines across four siloed systems (hospital EMR, GP, pharmacy, patient interview) via Zetaris, treats a missing source as unknown, ranks high-risk discrepancies first, and learns from pharmacist feedback which source to trust. Synthetic data only.

zetaris.role: data layer; agents get every fact by sending Lightning SQL to the Zetaris REST API
zetaris.status: four silos registered as REST tables plus a harmonised view, all query templates verified live on the dev machine; agent adapter pending

meterless.provider: Meterless Nightshift Runtime, OpenAI-compatible, primary AI provider for every model call
meterless.status: provider verified online and answering; engines pending

cursor.note: Not used. We build with Claude Code; CLAUDE.md is the single source of working rules.

nvidia.reached_via: Nightshift lanes only; the NVIDIA API key lives solely in Nightshift -> Setup -> Providers
nvidia.evidence: meterless.routed_model and winning_route in every trace event
nvidia.note: lane pinning is not honoured on Runtime m1-m4; the router chooses and we record what answered
